node.statement: By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, if the ambient space is an extended epsilon-C*-algebra then M_n tensor A is an epsilon-C*-algebra for every n >= 1; moreover P_n=I_n tensor P is a delta-projection whenever P is, since P_n^dagger=P_n, P_n^2-P_n=I_n tensor (P^2-P), and the block-diagonal operator norm satisfies ||I_n tensor Z||=||Z||, and likewise for Q_n and R_n.
